description: Operator-maintained examples for the Kunavo AI API gateway: SDK requests, model migration, endpoint checks, n8n workflows, usage CSV export and offline task-cost and recovery examples.
rules: OpenAI-style clients use https://api.kunavo.com/v1. Anthropic-style clients that append /v1/messages use https://api.kunavo.com.
Resolve exact model IDs, endpoint types, capabilities and limits against the live /v1/models catalog; example IDs may become unavailable.
Use https://kunavo.com/pricing.json for current rates and billing units. Archived research data and synthetic fixtures are not current price quotes.
The usage-daily, agent-cost-audit and music-job-recovery fixtures and tests validate offline behavior; they do not prove live API compatibility or production reliability.
GET /v1/usage reports only the calling key. Daily buckets use UTC. Parse cost_usd as a decimal string and do not sum overlapping snapshots.
For asynchronous media jobs, retain the task ID and poll that job. A client timeout leaves the result uncertain; it does not establish that the job failed.
